title: table2timetable
summary: Convert a table into a timetable.
description: `table2timetable(T, 'RowTimes', times)` converts table variables into a timetable with row-time metadata.
behaviors: Provided row times must match table height and keep all table variables as data variables.
If row times are omitted, RunMat consumes the first variable only when it is datetime-like or duration-like; otherwise sequential numeric row times are generated and all variables are retained.
